plugins.name: aipos
plugins.description: AIPOS skills for product strategy, evidence-based discovery, rapid validation, and governed AI-assisted delivery. Create and evolve product opportunity briefs, plan exploration, facilitate solution design canvases, test assumptions, define and refine behavior, select release scope, prepare commitment packages, check repository readiness, visualize work, generate synthetic data, and emit delivery metrics. Skills support the pillars and their handoffs in one installation; product approval remains with the accountable authority.
